n: Trading post at Red Cedar Lake (1878 map)
pl: T36N R10W sec. 22, at the outlet of Red Cedar Lake by the dam, town of Cedar Lake
v: Fur-trade and logging-era goods: trade silver, beads, gunflints, tokens, coins
st: The 1878 county atlas prints TRADING POST beside the dam at the south end of Red Cedar Lake, with a logging camp just west and another camp on the east shore. A trading post on the lake outlet in the 1870s would have traded with Ojibwe families and supplied the pine camps. Nothing on today's map marks it; the dam site and the old road along the outlet are the ground to read.
t: Turn on the 1800s map type to see the 1878 page over today's map, then check a 1938 aerial (WHAIFinder) and LiDAR for old lanes, cellar holes and building flats. Private land: ask first.
